direct_gap_statements: The publication gives the Hamiltonian and limiting phase boundary but not the exact square sizes, mass-search grid, extrapolation model, or stopping rule used for the red numerical curve; the accepted artifact uses L=12-24.

direct_cause.statement: The publication gives the Hamiltonian and limiting phase boundary but not the exact square sizes, mass-search grid, extrapolation model, or stopping rule used for the red numerical curve; the accepted artifact uses L=12-24.

root_cause.statement: The finite-size phase-boundary protocol behind Main Fig. 1 is not uniquely specified in the paper or supplement.

code_fault_assessment.statement: No defect was found in the clean-room Bloch-fan and finite-size boundary path under the predeclared discriminator; this does not recover the unpublished paper-exact extrapolation protocol.

checks.statement: The Bloch-fan symmetry residual is zero for the frozen Hamiltonian check.
The coarse/refined square-size boundary shift is 0.08, below the predeclared 0.161 discriminator.
The confirmed paper/source audit identifies the exact target-specific sizes, grids, fit rules, or state-selection inputs that the publication does not provide.
The focused campaign ran in an isolated minimal-input bundle with zero forbidden access.
